findings.evidence: Primitive.lean:198-200 `theorem not_isPrimitive_zpow ... := fun h => h.ne_zpow (y := x) hn rfl`; Primitive.lean:182-186 ne_zpow.
findings.fix: Keep `not_isPrimitive_zpow`, proved directly via `Group.natAbs_eq_one_of_not_isProperPower_zpow` and `Int.isUnit_iff_natAbs_eq`, and delete `IsPrimitive.ne_zpow`. Callers can write `fun h => not_isPrimitive_zpow y hn (h ▸ hx)`.
findings.issue: `IsPrimitive.ne_zpow` (hx : IsPrimitive x) : x ≠ y ^ n is the same result as `not_isPrimitive_zpow` (line 198) in a different form: each follows from the other in one line (`fun h => h.ne_zpow hn rfl`, or conversely `fun h => not_isPrimitive_zpow y hn (h ▸ hx)`). This leaves two public APIs for one fact.

findings.evidence: Primitive.lean:203-204 `theorem not_isPrimitive_pow ... := fun h => h.ne_pow (y := x) hn rfl`; ne_pow at 189-196 uses `Nat.isUnit_iff.mp (Int.ofNat_isUnit.mp hu)`.
findings.fix: Delete `IsPrimitive.ne_pow` and prove `not_isPrimitive_pow x hn` as `by simpa only [zpow_natCast] using not_isPrimitive_zpow x (n := n) (by simpa [Int.ofNat_isUnit, Nat.isUnit_iff] using hn)`.
findings.issue: `IsPrimitive.ne_pow` has the same problem with `not_isPrimitive_pow` (line 203): each is a one-line restatement of the other. `ne_pow` also re-checks by hand that `IsUnit (n : ℤ)` forces `n = 1` instead of reducing to the integer lemma.

findings.evidence: A grep for `isPrimitive_of_mul_of` across code/TauCeti finds only its definition at Primitive.lean:137.
findings.fix: Delete `isPrimitive_of_mul_of`. Callers can use `by simpa using isPrimitive_of_mul_zpow a b hab 1`.
findings.issue: `isPrimitive_of_mul_of` is now just the `n = 1` case of the new `isPrimitive_of_mul_zpow`, proved as `simpa only [zpow_one] using isPrimitive_of_mul_zpow a b hab 1`, and nothing in the repo uses it. The PR deleted the basis-level `isPrimitive_mul` for the same reason.

summary: The integer Nielsen generalization and automorphism characterization reuse Mathlib's FreeGroup.lift, Equiv.ofFreeGroupEquiv and FreeGroupBasis.ofRepr/reindex and duplicate nothing found in Mathlib or TauCeti. The new power-obstruction API comes in two interchangeable copies, and the n = 1 special case isPrimitive_of_mul_of is kept even though nothing uses it.
